{{Recipe summary | Category = Recipes for dessert | Time = Cooking: 30 minutes
Cooling: 2+ hours | Difficulty = 2 }} {{Recipe}} ==Ingredients == *250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], cut into chunks *1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] Milo chocolate drink powder *1 cup [[Cookbook:Cocoa powder|cocoa powder]] *1 cup [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]] *3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] *About 1 cup water *2 packets Marie Biscuits, broken into quarters *1 cup Nestum Cereal flakes ==Procedure== # Melt the butter in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over low heat. [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] in the Milo chocolate powder, cocoa powder, and condensed milk. # Mix in the eggs and water. Cook, stirring, until thickened. # Remove from the heat, and stir in the biscuit pieces and cereal flakes so everything is well coated with the chocolate mixture. # Transfer the mixture into a mold (e.g. [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]], aluminum tin, tupperware) that has been lined with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]] or [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic]]. # Tap the mold a few times on a hard surface to even everything out. # Let cool completely, then unmold and cut into slices. steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat. Whisk in the Milo chocolate powder, cocoa powder, and condensed milk.
Mix in the eggs and water. Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Remove from the heat, and stir in the biscuit pieces and cereal flakes so everything is well coated with the chocolate mixture.
Transfer the mixture into a mold (e.g. cake pan, aluminum tin, tupperware) that has been lined with parchment or plastic.
Tap the mold a few times on a hard surface to even everything out.
Let cool completely, then unmold and cut into slices.
